column1: # Experiment A1 (docs/experiments-round2.md): 8 new entries for the natural large-entry tier.
# Deviation from the design: design: sample of up to 400, 16 entries; run: sample of up to 200 and 8 entries (smaller budget at the user's request).

# Rule: eligible phenotype entries (causal gene recorded, >= 5 HPO phenotype annotations, >= 1 OMIM paragraph about a cited paper) with 30-150 references, in no existing evaluation set; seeded random sample of up to 200; the 8 with the most references readable in full (ties by entry number), requiring >= 5.

# Seed 2611 (candidates sorted by MIM number, then random.Random(seed).shuffle); 6581 candidate phenotype entries with a gene link and HPO annotations, not in an existing evaluation set (142 excluded); 3417 walked to find 200 eligible (the sample).

# Full-text count: PubMed records of every cited paper fetched in batches; papers with a PMC id give an upper bound (n_pmc); entries resolved with the project's access resolution (evalset.describe_papers) in descending order of the bound until no unresolved bound could reach the last selected place (124 resolved).
# Every selected entry has at least 5 references readable in full (lowest: 9).
# Selection finished: 124 of 200 sampled entries resolved; the 76 unresolved have bounds <= 8, below the last selected count (9), so none can enter.
# Top 8 from the resolved counts: 155600 168600 152700 114500 603075 222100 273300 312750 (same as the rows below).
# Run entry 155600: place in the top 8 certain from 03:39:32 (log line 5 of the 'resolved' lines), run started 04:04:39; final rank 1.
# Run entry 168600: place in the top 8 certain from 04:47:31 (log line 38 of the 'resolved' lines), run started 04:58:39; final rank 2.
# Run entry 152700: place in the top 8 certain from 05:27:58 (log line 65 of the 'resolved' lines), run started 06:02:10; final rank 3.
# Run entry 114500: place in the top 8 certain from 05:41:25 (log line 79 of the 'resolved' lines), run started 06:59:52; final rank 4.
# Run in A1 (generated and scored, run largeft), in rule order: 155600 168600 152700 114500; selected but not run: 603075 222100 273300 312750 (budget: see results/largeft/large_tier.md).
